sourceNotes: 在线更新接入 Sparkle，保留检查策略、跳过版本和系统通知
更新摘要支持中英文，跟随应用语言显示
卸载列表就绪后即可操作，应用大小在后台计算
修复取消在线更新后仍可能继续安装的问题，并在安装前协调桌面小组件退出
修复卸载时可能退出 XStats 自身、删除期间改变选择
修复跳过版本时误提示“已是最新版本”，以及已发现的新版本被后续检查失败隐藏的问题
修复关闭公网 IP 查询或暂停监控后，旧请求仍可能回写结果与缓存的问题

en: Use Sparkle for online updates while preserving check schedules, skipped versions, and system notifications. Downloads start only after clicking Install; older versions can upgrade through their existing update entry point
Show update summaries in Chinese for Chinese app languages and in English for all other app languages; GitHub Releases also include both languages
Make the uninstall list usable as soon as it is ready, measure app sizes in the background, and cancel previous scans when leaving the page or refreshing
Fix updates continuing to install after cancellation and coordinate desktop widget shutdown before installation
Prevent quitting XStats itself during uninstall, changing selections during removal, and removing Dock icons when only leftover files are cleaned
Fix skipped versions being reported as up to date and previously discovered updates disappearing after a later check fails
Prevent old public IP requests from overwriting results or cache after lookup is disabled or monitoring is paused
